newsitem.title: ITALY: Olivetti wins 40 mln stg Barclays contract.
newsitem.headline: Olivetti wins 40 mln stg Barclays contract.

text.p: Olivetti's Olsy company on Friday announced it had renewed a hardware maintenance and installation contract with British banking group Barclays Plc in a deal worth 40-50 million pounds ($83.6 million) over the next three years.

Olsy, which is Olivetti's information technology solution and services company, said the agreement concerned maintenance of over 120,000 hardware items included most of Barclays' automatic teller machines, branch and departmental equipment.
The agreement commenced on July 1 1997, and extends a decade of relationship between Barclays and Olsy, an Olivetti statement said.

Olsy, formerly called Olivetti Systems and Services, is the largest company in the Olivetti group and provides computer systems to a number of sectors including banking, retailing and public authorities.

"Olsy had proved that it can meet and exceed our service requirements. The company presented us with a competitive tender and a successful track record in supporting Barclays' information technology systems," said Joe Clements, director IT Services Management at Barclays in the statement. ($ = 0.598 British Pounds)
